personal_info.name: MIGUEL MAURICIO MENDOZA MENDOZA
personal_info.professional_summary: Biomedical Engineer and AI/ML Specialist with a Master of Science Degree in Information Processing. Passionate about bridging the gap between healthcare and cutting-edge artificial intelligence. I possess a strong background in designing and developing advanced AI-driven solutions, heavily leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), LangChain, LangGraph, and Vector Databases to build autonomous agents and robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. My career is defined by a deep commitment to innovation, transforming complex clinical data into actionable insights through Machine Learning, and deploying scalable AI systems that significantly improve healthcare processes and patient outcomes.
